summary: Verified the first slice of GAP-0006 as recommended in the gap record: additive outcome capture with no change to INVOCATION_STATUSES. The root cause was one level below the record schema. Provider.ask returned str, so ClaudeProvider discarded response.stop_reason and response.usage inside the adapter, and a thinking-only response and a complete response both reached the capture path as text. Provider gains an abstract ask_with_outcome returning ProviderOutcome; both adapters implement it; ask is unchanged and its five other callers are unaffected. InvocationRecord gains an optional outcome block carrying stop_reason, stop_reason_field, input_tokens, output_tokens, content_block_types and text_chars. Verified additive: a test asserts the invocation_id is identical with and without the block, because IDENTITY_FIELDS_V1 contains no outcome field, so no stored record's identity changes. Records without the block still validate, which the 182 stored records require. A provider reporting no outcome yields no block rather than a block of nulls, since nulls would read as capture. The two providers are not normalised onto a shared vocabulary: Anthropic reports stop_reason, the OpenAI Responses API reports status or incomplete_details.reason, and stop_reason_field records which field the value came from. NOT verified and out of scope: the third INVOCATION_STATUSES value, which the gap record identifies as migration-required and reserves for a separate decision. The 182 existing records remain uncaptured as to outcome, accurately.
